name: GATE
whoShouldTake: Engineering, science, architecture, and humanities graduates pursuing postgraduate study, research, or eligible PSU recruitment.
eligibility: Eligibility depends on the qualifying degree and current GATE information brochure; candidates in specified years of study may also apply.

pattern.structure: General Aptitude plus subject-specific test paper; paper combinations and marks are defined in the current brochure.
pattern.marking: Question types and negative marking vary by question; check the current brochure.

schedule.status: Annual schedule; confirm the next cycle on the official organizer website.
schedule.note: These are past-cycle dates, not upcoming dates. The official schedule says dates may change.

opportunities: Postgraduate admission and research opportunities; some PSUs recruit through GATE scores, subject to each employer's notice.

name: CAT
whoShouldTake: Graduates seeking management programmes at IIMs and other participating institutions.
eligibility: A bachelor's degree is generally required; minimum marks, category relaxations, and final-year rules follow the current CAT notification.

pattern.structure: Verbal Ability and Reading Comprehension, Data Interpretation and Logical Reasoning, and Quantitative Ability.
pattern.duration: Set by the current CAT notification
pattern.marking: Question formats and scoring rules are specified in the current notification.

schedule.status: Annual schedule; registration and test dates are published in the current CAT notification.

opportunities: Admission to MBA and related postgraduate programmes; selection also depends on each institution's shortlisting and interview process.

name: GRE
whoShouldTake: Students whose target graduate programmes accept or require GRE scores.
eligibility: ETS does not set a general academic eligibility requirement; confirm each university's admission requirements.

pattern.mode: Computer-delivered test; availability varies by location
pattern.structure: Analytical Writing, Verbal Reasoning, and Quantitative Reasoning.
pattern.duration: Check the current ETS test description
pattern.marking: Scores and section details are defined by ETS.

schedule.status: Test availability and appointment dates depend on location; book through the official ETS site.

opportunities: Graduate programme applications where the institution accepts GRE scores; requirements differ by university and programme.

name: UPSC Civil Services Examination
whoShouldTake: Graduates seeking recruitment to the civil services covered by the current UPSC notification.
eligibility: A bachelor's degree is generally required. Age limits, attempts, relaxations, and service-specific conditions are governed by the current notification.

pattern.preliminary: Objective papers; qualifying and merit rules are set by the current notification.
pattern.main: Written papers including qualifying and merit papers as notified for that cycle.

schedule.status: UPSC publishes an annual examination calendar; use the current calendar and exam notice for confirmed dates.

opportunities: Recruitment to services listed in the current UPSC notification, subject to rank, preferences, vacancies, and eligibility.

name: SSC Combined Graduate Level (CGL)
whoShouldTake: Graduates interested in central government posts notified through SSC CGL.
eligibility: A bachelor's degree is generally required; age limits, post-specific qualifications, and relaxations vary by post and current notification.

pattern.stages: Tier structure and any post-specific tests are defined by the current SSC CGL notice.

schedule.status: Dates and application windows are announced in the SSC calendar and cycle-specific notification.

opportunities: Recruitment to central government posts listed in the relevant SSC CGL vacancy notice.

name: IBPS Probationary Officer
whoShouldTake: Graduates seeking probationary officer roles at participating public sector banks.
eligibility: Graduation and age criteria are set in the current IBPS notification; category relaxations and document rules apply.

pattern.marking: Sections, timing, and penalties are set by the current notification.

schedule.status: IBPS publishes an annual calendar and separate recruitment notifications; verify the current cycle.

opportunities: Probationary officer recruitment at participating banks, subject to that year's participating-bank list and vacancies.

name: SBI Probationary Officer
whoShouldTake: Graduates interested in officer recruitment at State Bank of India.
eligibility: Degree, age, category relaxation, and final-year conditions must be checked in the current SBI recruitment notice.

stages: Psychometric assessment/interview or group exercise as notified
pattern.marking: The current notification defines the structure and selection weights.

schedule.status: SBI announces vacancies and dates through individual recruitment notices; no fixed annual exam date.

opportunities: Officer recruitment at SBI when notified; vacancies and service conditions vary by recruitment cycle.

name: RRB NTPC
whoShouldTake: Candidates seeking railway non-technical posts listed in an RRB NTPC recruitment notice.
eligibility: Educational qualifications and age limits depend on the post level and current notification; check the official CEN notice.

stages: Skill or aptitude test for applicable posts
pattern.marking: Stage structure and negative marking are defined by the current CEN.

schedule.status: Recruitment calendars and exam dates are issued by Railway Recruitment Boards; verify the current CEN and regional RRB notices.

opportunities: Railway posts included in the applicable NTPC Centralised Employment Notice.

name: JEE Main
whoShouldTake: Students applying to NITs, IIITs, other participating institutions, or JEE Advanced subject to eligibility.
eligibility: Attempt limits, year-of-passing conditions, and admission criteria are defined by the current NTA and institution notices.

pattern.sessions: Session count, paper structure, duration, and scoring are specified in the current information bulletin.

schedule.status: NTA publishes session dates and application windows in the current JEE Main information bulletin.

opportunities: Admission consideration at participating institutions according to current counselling rules and institute eligibility.

name: JEE Advanced
whoShouldTake: Eligible JEE Main candidates seeking undergraduate admission at IITs.
eligibility: Shortlisting, attempt limits, age, qualifying examination, and subject requirements are defined by the current JEE Advanced brochure.

pattern.papers: Two compulsory papers; question formats and marking rules may vary by paper and year.

schedule.status: The organizing IIT publishes the current year's dates and information brochure.

opportunities: IIT undergraduate programmes through the applicable joint seat allocation process.

name: UGC NET
whoShouldTake: Postgraduate candidates pursuing eligibility for Assistant Professor, Junior Research Fellowship, or doctoral admission categories as notified.
eligibility: Qualification, minimum marks, age limits for JRF, exemptions, and category rules are defined by the current NTA bulletin.

pattern.papers: Paper I (teaching/research aptitude) and Paper II (chosen subject); check the current bulletin for duration and marking.

schedule.status: NTA announces examination cycles and dates through official UGC NET notices.

opportunities: Eligibility outcomes for teaching, research, and doctoral admission as defined for the result category and current rules.

name: NEET UG
whoShouldTake: Eligible candidates seeking undergraduate medical admissions through the NEET UG process.
eligibility: Subjects, qualifying examination, age, and category requirements are set in the current NTA information bulletin and applicable regulations.

pattern.mode: As notified by NTA for the current cycle
pattern.marking: Question count, duration, and scoring must be checked in the current bulletin.

schedule.status: NTA publishes application and examination dates in the current information bulletin.

Physics: Class 11 and 12 topics in the current syllabus
Chemistry: Physical, inorganic, and organic chemistry in the current syllabus
Biology: Botany and zoology topics in the current syllabus

opportunities: Admission counselling for medical programmes under applicable national and state processes.

name: CUET UG
whoShouldTake: Students applying to universities and programmes participating in CUET UG.
eligibility: Programme-specific subject, age, and qualifying requirements are determined by each participating university and the current CUET bulletin.

pattern.mode: As specified in the current NTA bulletin
pattern.selection: Subject combinations and score requirements vary by university and programme.

schedule.status: NTA publishes the current cycle dates and subject information in its CUET UG bulletin.

Domain subjects: Subject syllabi aligned to the notified curriculum

opportunities: Admission consideration at participating universities under their published programme-specific rules.

name: ISRO Scientist/Engineer Recruitment
whoShouldTake: Engineering graduates interested in technical roles at ISRO.
eligibility: Disciplines, degree requirements, marks, age, and selection method vary by recruitment advertisement.

pattern.selection: Written test and/or other stages as stated in the specific recruitment advertisement.
pattern.subjects: Branch-specific engineering topics and any other sections listed in the advertisement.

schedule.status: Recruitment is advertisement-based; there is no fixed exam date applicable to every post.

Engineering: Core subjects for the advertised discipline
Other sections: Only as specified in the current recruitment advertisement

opportunities: Scientist/Engineer and other technical posts advertised by ISRO centres.

name: DRDO CEPTAM
whoShouldTake: Candidates seeking technical and administrative roles advertised by DRDO through CEPTAM.
eligibility: Qualification, discipline, age, and selection stages are post-specific; use the current DRDO advertisement.

pattern.stages: Tier and skill/trade tests depend on the post and current advertisement.
pattern.subjects: Technical topics, reasoning, quantitative aptitude, or general awareness as specified for the post.

schedule.status: Recruitment is notification-based; check DRDO's current vacancies for dates.

opportunities: Technical and support positions listed in current DRDO CEPTAM notifications.
